scientific_anchor.survey_semantics: year- and patch-specific binary detection histories from faecal latrine surveys, 1–4 visits per breeding season
scientific_anchor.registry_semantics: riparian suitable-habitat patches are temporally stable and were mapped independently of future occupancy; masked released XY values retain relative network structure for reproducibility
scientific_anchor.process_boundary: classic fragmented metapopulation with frequent occupancy turnover and dispersal among suitable patches embedded in unsuitable heather matrix; later source/process closure must still be certified before response access

readme_only_stage.purpose: use only the exact README to map released file/object roles and determine whether a complete masked 98-node spatial registry is physically separable from longitudinal detection/occupancy response before opening any RData or model-output payload
readme_only_stage.transport_fallback_rule: the second route is allowed only for the same immutable README file id and only if the first route returns an HTTP transport denial; exact byte size and SHA-256 must match before decoding
readme_only_stage.stop_rule: if README transport fails on both frozen routes, or README establishes that complete geometry and ecological response cannot be physically separated under a prospective file/object contract, close this attempt before response access

future_endpoint_boundary.provisional_endpoint: one-year-ahead patch occupancy/detection state under a frozen observation rule; final physical response semantics must be fixed from response-independent README/schema evidence before any response row access
future_endpoint_boundary.learner_boundary: same frozen strong random forest in baseline and augmented arms; only unchanged 10-column Layer B may differ
